Muscle sn-1,2-diacylglycerol (DAG) and C18:0 ceramide accumulation in sarcolemmal and mitochondrial compartments have been proposed to regulate muscle insulin sensitivity. Here, we evaluated whether weight loss-induced improvements in insulin sensitivity were associated with changes in muscle sn-1,2-DAG and ceramide content in people with obesity and type 2 diabetes.
